title: Reverse a Linked List
prompt:
You are given the head of a singly linked list built from `ListNode` values (each has a `val` and a `next: Option<Box<ListNode>>`). Reverse the list in place (re-link the existing nodes; do not allocate new ones) and return the new head. An empty list is `None`.

Signature: `fn reverse_list(head: Option<Box<ListNode>>) -> Option<Box<ListNode>>`

The starter provides `ListNode::from_vec` and `ListNode::to_vec` helpers.

Example:
  1 -> 2 -> 3 -> None   becomes   3 -> 2 -> 1 -> None
